# Orb puffer, phase 3 (splat fit + the scene's parts, generated by make_puffer.py): run after p2 with --no-save.
select Plinth Drum Lid
scale 1 0.9 1
apply --scale
select all
export puffer_splat.glb
select Plinth Drum Lid Hose Arm Cup
export puffer_base.glb --selection
select Barrel Mouth
translate 0 0 -1.330
export puffer_barrel.glb --selection
translate 0 0 1.330
select Bulb
translate 0.680 0 -0.790
export puffer_bulb.glb --selection
